title: Normalized canonical lift and localized convolution data
statement: For a commutative ring R there exist canonical tensor localization data on the finite filtered derived module category [def-kun-finite-filtered-module-homotopy]. These consist of a lift T from bounded derived module objects, a forgetful functor omega, associated graded functors gr^i, and a convolution bifunctor star. There are natural isomorphisms omega T ≅ inclusion and gr^i T ≅ H^-i followed by single in degree zero and shift by i. The functors omega and gr^i are naturally normalized on every finite filtered complex by its ordinary complex and associated graded complex. The underlying star(U,V) is naturally omega(U) tensor^L omega(V). For every a,U,V there is finite support s for the tensors gr^i(U) tensor^L gr^(a-i)(V), and gr^a(star(U,V)) is isomorphic to their finite biproduct. These isomorphisms are natural for maps on a common support. They agree under support enlargement with the inclusion characterized by its biproduct summand inclusions. The record CanonicalTensorLocalizationData states all these equations explicitly.

proof.text: Take the canonical truncation lift T with its normalized forgetful and grading functors. Independently take the localized filtered tensor construction, retaining its forgetful and grading functors, convolution, tensor comparison, finite support and support extension equations.

Normalize the convolution functors on actual filtered complexes using the localization lifting isomorphisms, their stated object and map equations, and the natural quotient-to-derived comparison. Descend natural isomorphisms comparing these functors to the canonical lift functors, since precomposition with the filtered homotopy quotient and localization is fully faithful. Whisker these comparisons by T and compose with its canonical forgetful and graded comparisons. Package the resulting maps and original convolution equations in the record; no arbitrary unproved construction is used.
